audit.gpu_probe_scope: text generation with MTP disabled; no new derivative vision/MTP functionality check

limits: The 72 requests are a bounded diagnostic on three selected MSE histories, not a new GPQA evaluation.
The formal journals and checkpoints remain separate from these diagnostic outputs; no formal score is updated.
Journal text was retokenized. The original generated token IDs and incremental KV/SSM decode states are unavailable.
Radix/prefix cache was enabled. Replay does not establish a full fresh prefill for every request.
Deterministic inference was disabled and no repeated or cache-cleared runs were made; small score changes cannot establish a precision cause.

max and MSE use independently calibrated exports, including dynamic versus static weight block scales and recomputed activation statistics; synthetic equal activation scales do not establish equality of full-checkpoint activation scales.
The max comparison tests supplied MSE histories, not natural loop-entry probability from the original questions.
Candidate group scores are best individual token logprobs, not raw logits or probabilities of complete ending sequences.
A 512-token length finish means the diagnostic budget was exhausted, not the formal 262144-context truncation.
A long original period can exceed the rollout budget. Original-cycle matching is required even when within-output repetition is absent.
A zero prior-context 32-token match can occur when only two short cycles were supplied; it does not establish loop exit.
Restoring attention projections changes both weights and their activation precision path; it does not isolate those causes or restore all attention operations to BF16.
FP8 KV, FP32 SSM, and already-BF16 GDN components were retained by the frozen protocol.
The derivative manifests record offline payload checks, not an additional current checkpoint rehash or new vision/MTP functionality validation. MTP was disabled here.
The processor was a single read-only source override in the original frozen image. This is not a clean build or GPU validation of a newly built image.
The frozen driver checked the running processor hash before each ready marker. Provenance does not claim an additional independent recheck of stopped containers.
Request timing is not a controlled throughput comparison; startup and prefix-cache conditions differ.
A changed first token, new words, or disappearance of a short loop does not establish full stopping recovery, general quality improvement, or the quantization root cause.

protocol.candidate_group_semantics: best single-token logprob, not sequence probability

scope: All six canonical recovery models completed the same 9 one-token and 3 bounded inside-loop requests with the same frozen runtime override.

source.bundle_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON object serialization
